name: model-router
description: Saves credits by reading each task and picking the lightest model that will do it well, for subagents and, when switching is cheap, the main conversation. Cache-aware, so it never trades a cheap model for an expensive cache rebuild.

mode.title: Routing mode
mode.description: conservative: route subagents only. balanced (default): also run light questions on Sonnet when switching is cheap. aggressive: also run standard work on Sonnet and light questions on Haiku. off: route nothing.

switchBudgetTokens.title: Cheap-switch context limit
switchBudgetTokens.description: Only move the main conversation to a lighter model while its context is under this many tokens, or its prompt cache has gone cold anyway. Above it, re-caching costs more than the lighter model saves.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: 60 on a Claude subscription; 5 on API keys unless you set promptCacheTtl to 1h.
